content.text: Shifts come straight from the homes.
Miss Dona, adult family home owner

No agents. No fees.
Just the shift.
Lydia paid an agent a fee for a caregiving job.
The job never came. The agent stopped answering.
No agents. No fees. Caregivers never pay a cent.
The shifts come straight from the homes that need you.
Miss Dona runs an adult family home.
She posts her open shift herself, in about a minute.
Lydia sees the real home, the real hours and the real pay before she applies.
She picks the days and nights that suit her.
and the two of them can message directly. No one in the middle.
The shift is covered. Miss Dona pays Lydia directly,
